guia.what: A full-width message for a page-wide or app-wide status. It carries a semantic icon based on the variant and optional actions, and it can be dismissible (`data-ts-dismissible`) or stick to the top (`is-sticky`).
whenUse: The message affects the whole page or the whole app, like an outage, an expired plan, or maintenance mode.
It has to be seen on arrival, without the user looking for it.
It can carry an action to resolve it right there (retry, upgrade the plan).
whenAvoid: The notice is about part of the content, not the whole page → `note`.
It confirms something the user just did and can go away on its own → `toast`.
It’s an error on a form field → the `field` `error`.
dos: One banner at a time. If two compete, neither gets read.
Put the way out in the banner itself—what happened and what to do about it.
If it’s `is-sticky`, make it dismissible—a fixed banner that won’t go away gets in the way.
donts: Don’t use it as a permanent ad. People stop seeing it, and it covers content.
Don’t let color carry the meaning alone. The text has to say it.

nucleo: The banner can be dismissed, and Core handles that. The close button removes the banner from the DOM (or hides it) and, when needed, remembers that it was dismissed.
